text: Rule RQ-001 requires that "Dates are in order: checked/approved not before drawn; revision dates ascending with revision" [R:RQ-001]. It is a minor-severity code check sourced from Team requirements docs/01_discovery.md (PARI proxy, 2026-10-13), US-3.3 AC2 [R:RQ-001]. On this drawing it failed because the checked date (25/09/2025) is before the drawn date (01/10/2025) [F2].
